page.layout: One block of italic verse in a single column, centred on the page. No margin notes. Below the last verse line, at the right, one catchword, "Tripodum".

p.i: Puræque concors Veritatis adfectus Sororiâ cum Caritate proscriptus, Orbemque totum demigrans sub extremam Concessit Arcton; indidemque porrigo Subiit novandi, & immodesta libertas Per sacra eundi, per profana, per fas & Nefas ruendi, quà procacior quemque Trahit lubido, & illa cochleæ in morem Cuniculosâ hypocrisis latens testâ, Intraque se reposita cratibus septem Longe reductis, Religioque plus centum Plicis striata: quando flebile Europa Pomum momordit; ambitusque non viles Venatus animas; pestilensque & haut unâ Sanabile anticyrâ usque & usque rixandi Corda cacoëthes insolenter insedit; Studiisque tot divortiisque discordes Famosa Erinnys usque lancinat fratres, Odiisque scindit. Unde tanta pugnandi Talisque rabies? candidis quis indixit Hæc bella calamis? anne dura Cadmeis Enata sulcis se novissimè in nostris Resevit agris ferreum seges fratrum, Cerita pubes, quæ, videnté ridente Hoste, invicem se conficit suis telis? Parum cruentos ergo visa sumsisse Orchestra vultûs, luctuosa quamdudum Bellona gressu concurrit cothurnato, Formidoloso Europen efferans cantu In se manûs convertere & suas gnatas, Aquilisque prohibens & Leonibus somnos; Nisi igne sacro se quoque & sacris pascat Vulgus favillis, mobile & suo semper Favens periculo? Ah! digna pluribus perdi Gens, quàm quibus quotidie peris, damnis Non absque sumtu! quem Sinona, quod muris Ferale Dolopum credula invehis monstrum, Dolitura serò, (& serò, scis, Phryges quondam Sapuere) nunc quod triste guadium gaudes? Quid si docentis ipse, Lector, haurires Responsa ab ore, nemo qualia audivit

page.notes: Lines are set in italic throughout with a large decorated initial Q in "Quid". Several words are damaged or doubtful: "Puræque" (æ ligature partly worn), "Cerita" and "videnté" (final letters unclear), "anticyrâ", "Resevit" and "cruentos", which may read differently in the original. The catchword "Tripodum" is printed at the lower right, not in the text.
